title: Timelines: 100+ Time Travel Journeys in Popular TV & Film
content:
Every major time-travel journey in popular film and TV, plotted on one looping, interactive, crazy-ass timeline. Kinda looks the way time-travel feels.

We first made a static graphic of this back in 2009. But now it’s updated and interactive, so you can fly through the data.

And see some meta-moments where time travellers from different franchises might potentially meet

Includes Back to the Future, Bill & Ted, Terminator, plus a LOT of Star Trek. But excludes Doctor Who of course. That would be ridiculous. Or would it?

Let us know if we’ve missed any!
author: David McCandless
